card.title: 91st ASTRAKHAN
card.text: When this unit gets a Pincer effect, give it +1+2.
card.flavorText: The 91st Astrakhan was an infantry regiment of the 31st Rifle Division of the Red Army during WWII. At the start of the war, the division joined the newly formed 45th Army, guarding the Turkish border. After heavy losses in the Battle of Kiev and the Donbas, the division was sent north to fill the gap. It participated in the Battle of Rostov and the Mius defensive operations. During the German offensive of 1942, known as Case Blue, the division retreated into the Caucasus. It was later transferred to the 12th Army and then to the 18th Army of the North Caucasian Front. The division suffered significant losses in the defense of Tuapse but received reinforcements. As the German retreat from the Caucasus began, the division joined the 46th Army, advancing along the Black Sea coast. In 1943, the division was moved north and joined the Southwestern Front before becoming part of the 3rd Ukrainian Front. During the Battle of the Dnieper, it was transferred to the 4th Guards Army of the 2nd Ukrainian Front. The division participated in the Second Jassy-Kishinev Offensive, advancing into Romania. It later fought in the Vistula-Oder Offensive and the Berlin Offensive. Throughout the war, the division received prestigious awards such as the Order of the Red Banner, the Order of Suvorov 2nd class, and the Order of Bogdan Khmelnitsky 2nd class.
